headline: Record AI-driven quarter lifts margins to new highs
summary_short: Revenue rose 48% y/y to $22.19B on accelerating AI semiconductor demand, with GAAP operating margin expanding to 48.9% of revenue. Diluted EPS of $1.91 grew 85% y/y, and the company guided Q3 revenue to approximately $29.4B.
summary_long: Q2 revenue grew 48% y/y to $22.19B, led by AI semiconductor revenue of $10.8B (+143% y/y) on custom AI accelerator and networking demand, which management said outpaced its own forecast. GAAP operating income rose 84% y/y to $10.86B (shard KPI; the release's own GAAP operating income line shows $10,788M — see confidence notes) and diluted EPS of $1.91 was up 85% y/y. Free cash flow was $10.26B (46% of revenue) on $10.49B of operating cash flow less $231M capex. Cash and equivalents rose to $19.63B from $14.17B q/q. The company declared a $0.65/share quarterly dividend and guided Q3 revenue to approximately $29.4B (+84% y/y), with non-GAAP operating margin near 67% of revenue.

drivers.explanation: Growth led by semiconductor solutions (+79% y/y to $15.0B, 68% of revenue); AI semiconductor revenue alone reached $10.8B, +143% y/y, on demand for custom AI accelerators and networking. Infrastructure software grew just 9% y/y.
CFO attributed the margin expansion directly to "strong operating leverage" from scaling AI-driven revenue growth against a slower-growing cost base.

Net income grew 87.5% y/y, lagging pretax income's 99% y/y growth, because the tax provision rose to $820M from just $120M a year ago (effective rate ~8% vs ~2%) — not addressed narratively in the release.

CEO Hock Tan called it a record quarter for revenue, operating profit and free cash flow, driven by "accelerating growth in AI semiconductor revenue and strong operating leverage," and guided AI semiconductor revenue growth to exceed 200% y/y next quarter.
